answer: Here is one mechanism that works: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because gale only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, dawn is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any signal approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
